questions.prompt: Who is the hobbit Ring-bearer entrusted with the quest to destroy the One Ring?
questions.explanation: Frodo inherited the Ring from his uncle Bilbo and took on the task of destroying it.

questions.prompt: Which wizard guides the Fellowship of the Ring, first as 'the Grey' and later as 'the White'?
questions.explanation: Gandalf is a wizard sent to Middle-earth to help resist Sauron; he returns renewed after a perilous fall.

questions.prompt: Who is Frodo's loyal gardener and companion on the quest to destroy the Ring?
questions.explanation: Sam stays at Frodo's side through the whole quest, even when Frodo can barely go on.

questions.prompt: Which creature, obsessed with the Ring, calls it 'my precious'?
questions.explanation: Gollum possessed the Ring for centuries, and it twisted his mind and body.

questions.prompt: Which Dark Lord forged the One Ring to rule the other Rings of Power?
questions.explanation: Sauron made the One Ring long ago, pouring much of his own power into it.

questions.prompt: Which Elf, famous for his skill with the bow, is a member of the Fellowship?
questions.explanation: Legolas, son of King Thranduil of the Woodland Realm, represents the Elves in the Fellowship.

questions.prompt: Which Dwarf is a member of the Fellowship of the Ring?
questions.explanation: Gimli, son of Glóin, is the Dwarf who walks with the Fellowship.

questions.prompt: Which Ranger, known to the hobbits as Strider, protects them on a dangerous road and joins the Fellowship?
questions.explanation: Aragorn, a Ranger of the North, protects the hobbits on the road and becomes one of the leaders of the Fellowship.

questions.prompt: Which wizard, once the head of his order, is corrupted by his desire for power and betrays the free peoples?
questions.explanation: Saruman, once head of the wizards' order, was corrupted by his desire for power.

questions.prompt: Who is the hobbit hero of The Hobbit?
questions.explanation: Bilbo joins Thorin's company as their burglar and brings home the Ring.

questions.prompt: Who rules Gondor as Steward during the War of the Ring, in the absence of a king?
questions.explanation: Denethor II ruled Gondor as Steward; Ecthelion was his father.

questions.prompt: Who is King Théoden's nephew, the son of his sister, who becomes King of Rohan after him?
questions.explanation: Éomer, son of Théoden's sister Théodwyn, becomes king after Théoden falls; Théodred, Théoden's own son, died before him.

questions.prompt: Who is the father of Arwen?
questions.explanation: Elrond Half-elven, Lord of Rivendell, is the father of Arwen and of the twins Elladan and Elrohir.

questions.prompt: What is the full name of the hobbit known as Merry?
questions.explanation: Merry is Frodo's cousin and a Brandybuck of Buckland.

questions.prompt: Which Elf-king rules the Woodland Realm of Mirkwood in The Hobbit?
questions.explanation: Thranduil is the father of Legolas and holds the halls where the Dwarves are imprisoned.

questions.prompt: Which lady of Rohan, the king's niece, refuses to be left behind when the Rohirrim ride to war?
questions.explanation: She longs for a place in the battle and rides to war in disguise.

questions.prompt: Which Elven lady shows Frodo and Sam her Mirror and gives parting gifts to the Fellowship?
questions.explanation: Galadriel is one of the oldest Elves in Middle-earth; her husband is Celeborn, and Celebrían is her daughter.

questions.prompt: Who is the younger son of the Steward of Gondor, captain of the Rangers of Ithilien?
questions.explanation: Faramir is the second son of the Steward and later becomes Prince of Ithilien.

questions.prompt: Who is the Dwarf leader of the company that sets out to reclaim Erebor in The Hobbit?
questions.explanation: Thorin is the grandson of Thrór, the last King under the Mountain before Smaug.

questions.prompt: Which wizard, called 'the Brown', once made his home at Rhosgobel, near Mirkwood, and was a friend of beasts and birds?
questions.explanation: Radagast the Brown made his home at Rhosgobel and was a friend of beasts and birds.

questions.prompt: Who is Aragorn's father?
questions.explanation: Arathorn II, Chieftain of the Dúnedain, died young; Arador was Aragorn's grandfather.

questions.prompt: Who is the mother of Éomer and Éowyn?
questions.explanation: Théodwyn was the sister of King Théoden; Morwen was Théoden's mother.

questions.prompt: Which Elven-smith forged the Three Rings of the Elves?
questions.explanation: Celebrimbor made them without Sauron's direct touch, which is why they were not bound to the One Ring.

questions.prompt: Which Maia, wife of King Thingol, protected the realm of Doriath with an enchanted girdle?
questions.explanation: Melian's protection kept Doriath hidden for ages; her daughter was Lúthien.

questions.prompt: Who was High King of the Noldor and ally of Elendil in the Last Alliance?
questions.explanation: Gil-galad ruled from Lindon and fell in the siege of Barad-dûr.

questions.prompt: Who is the father of the Dwarf Gimli?
questions.explanation: Glóin was one of Thorin's company in The Hobbit; Gróin was his own father.

questions.prompt: What is the name of Samwise Gamgee's eldest daughter?
questions.explanation: Sam named her after the golden flower seen in Lothlórien.

questions.prompt: Who is the mother of Elrond?
questions.explanation: Elwing was the mother of the twin brothers Elrond and Elros.

questions.prompt: Which Dwarf of Thorin's company later tried to re-establish a colony in Moria?
questions.explanation: Balin became Lord of Moria, but his colony was lost, and his tomb was found by the Fellowship.

questions.prompt: Who was the last King of Númenor, who took the Sceptre by marrying Tar-Míriel?
questions.explanation: Tar-Míriel was Tar-Palantir's daughter and the heir to the throne; Ar-Pharazôn's challenge to the Valar led to the destruction of Númenor.

questions.prompt: Which hobbit of the Took family, a cousin of Merry, is among the four hobbits who join the Fellowship?
questions.explanation: Peregrin 'Pippin' Took is the youngest of the hobbits who set out with the Fellowship.

questions.prompt: Which very fat Dwarf of Thorin's company falls into an enchanted stream and sleeps for a long time?
questions.explanation: Bombur sleeps through much of the journey after falling into the stream, and the others have to carry him.

questions.prompt: Which Elf-maiden gives up her immortality for the love of the mortal Man Beren?
questions.explanation: Lúthien Tinúviel, daughter of a king of the Elves and a Maia, chooses a mortal life to remain with Beren; she is an ancestor of Elrond and Arwen.

questions.prompt: Which skin-changer shelters Bilbo and the Dwarves in his hall and later joins the great battle that ends the quest?
questions.explanation: In The Hobbit, Beorn takes the form of a huge bear and turns the tide of the great battle at the end of the tale.

questions.prompt: Which monstrous spider guards the pass of Cirith Ungol and attacks Frodo and Sam?
questions.explanation: Shelob is a giant spider who lurks in the dark tunnels of the pass and preys on all who enter.

questions.prompt: Which sly counsellor of the King of Rohan is secretly serving the lord of Isengard?
questions.explanation: Gríma, called Wormtongue, poisons the king's mind with his master's help until Gandalf breaks the spell.

questions.prompt: Which jolly and mysterious master of the Old Forest sings merrily and is not affected by the power of the Ring?
questions.explanation: Tom Bombadil lives near the Old Forest with his wife Goldberry; when Frodo hands him the Ring, he puts it on and does not vanish.

questions.prompt: Which Steward of Gondor, overcome by despair, tries to burn himself and his wounded son on a pyre?
questions.explanation: Denethor, who has looked into a palantír, loses hope as the city is besieged and is stopped from burning his son.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the pony the travellers acquire on the road to carry their baggage?
questions.explanation: Bill the pony carries the Fellowship's baggage until he is sent away before the Fellowship enters the mountain.

questions.prompt: Which hobbit lass of Bywater, daughter of Farmer Cotton, marries Sam after the quest?
questions.explanation: Rosie Cotton marries Sam in the year 1420 of the Shire Reckoning.

questions.prompt: Which Guard of the Citadel leaves his post and sheds blood in the Hallows to save the Steward's younger son from the pyre?
questions.explanation: Beregond kills the porter of the Closed Door to save the Steward's son; as judgement, the king removes him from the Guard but makes him captain of the White Company, the guard of the Prince of Ithilien.

questions.prompt: Which Elf leads the company of wandering Elves that the hobbits meet in the Woody End of the Shire?
questions.explanation: Gildor Inglorion, of the House of Finrod, and his companions give the hobbits food and shelter for a night and some counsel.

questions.prompt: Which Ent, called Quickbeam in the Common Speech, is unusually hasty and loves the rowan trees?
questions.explanation: Bregalad is the Sindarin name of this Ent, and means 'quick-beam'; he is far quicker in speech and temper than other Ents.

questions.prompt: Who is the stout innkeeper of the Prancing Pony in Bree, who forgets to send Gandalf's letter?
questions.explanation: Barliman Butterbur's forgetfulness delays Gandalf's message to Frodo, though he later helps the hobbits.

questions.prompt: Which Prince of Dol Amroth leads the knights of his land to the defence of Minas Tirith?
questions.explanation: Imrahil the Fair commands the knights of Dol Amroth and later rides to the Black Gate with the Captains of the West.

questions.prompt: Which great steed, lord of the Mearas, becomes Gandalf's mount after being tamed by him?
questions.explanation: Shadowfax, chief of the Mearas, carries Gandalf without saddle or bridle.

questions.prompt: Who is the River-daughter, the wife of Tom Bombadil?
questions.explanation: Goldberry, called the River-daughter, lives with Tom Bombadil in their house near the forest and welcomes the hobbits there.

questions.prompt: Which relative of Bilbo, always trying to claim Bag End for herself, is known for her umbrella?
questions.explanation: Lobelia tries more than once to take over Bag End, but after her imprisonment in the Shire's troubles she leaves her money to help homeless hobbits.

questions.prompt: Which chieftain of the Wild Men of the Drúadan Forest guides the Rohirrim along a hidden way to Gondor?
questions.explanation: Ghân-buri-Ghân leads the Rohirrim on a secret path around the enemy, in return for a promise that his people will be left in peace.

questions.prompt: Which boy of Minas Tirith befriends Pippin and shows him around the city?
questions.explanation: Bergil, a boy of the city, becomes a friend of Pippin while the city prepares for war.

questions.prompt: Which Elf, Shipwright and Lord of the Grey Havens, entrusted the Ring Narya to Gandalf?
questions.explanation: Círdan the Shipwright held Narya, the Ring of Fire, until he gave it to Gandalf upon his arrival.

questions.prompt: Who was the mother of Aragorn?
questions.explanation: Gilraen the Fair, daughter of Dírhael, was wife of the Chieftain and mother of the heir, who was called Estel.

questions.prompt: Who ruled Gondor as Steward directly before Denethor?
questions.explanation: Ecthelion II, father of Denethor, was the Steward before him; he welcomed Gandalf in Minas Tirith.

questions.prompt: Who was the King of the Noldor and father of Fëanor, Fingolfin and Finarfin, slain by Morgoth at Formenos?
questions.explanation: Finwë led the Noldor to Valinor; his death at Formenos, when Morgoth stole the Silmarils, drove Fëanor to pursue Morgoth to Middle-earth.

questions.prompt: Which Steward of Gondor granted the land of Calenardhon to the Northmen led by Eorl?
questions.explanation: Cirion rewarded the Northmen's aid in battle with the lands that became Rohan.

questions.prompt: Which King of Rohan, son of Eorl the Young, built the Golden Hall of Meduseld?
questions.explanation: Brego built Meduseld on the hill of Edoras and held a feast on its completion.

questions.prompt: Who was the husband of Lobelia, a long-time rival of Bilbo over Bag End?
questions.explanation: Otho Sackville-Baggins, Lobelia's husband, was the father of Lotho, who later became a petty tyrant in the Shire.

questions.prompt: Who was Frodo Baggins's mother?
questions.explanation: Primula Brandybuck and her husband Drogo Baggins drowned in the Brandywine when Frodo was a boy.

questions.prompt: Who was the father of King Théoden of Rohan?
questions.explanation: Thengel was the son of Fengel and father of Théoden; he spent part of his life in Gondor.

questions.prompt: Who was the father of Elendil and the last Lord of Andúnië?
questions.explanation: Amandil, last Lord of Andúnië, was Elendil's father and sailed west to plead with the Valar.
